card.statement:
If $f$ is stratified semismall and locally trivial and if $\mathscr{F}$
is a perverse sheaf on $Y$ constructible with respect to $\mathscr{U}$ ,
then $f_{*}\mathscr{F}$ is a perverse sheaf on $X$ constructible with
respect to $\mathscr{T}$ .
card.label: Proposition 6.1

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
